title: FLA import: text field properties (password, maxChars, hasBorder, multiline flag, AS2 variable name) not mapped
description:
flash8-binary.ts parses CPicText textFlags byte (bit 0x04=password, bit 0x10=multiline, bit 0x40=border) and the maxCharacters u16 (line 1833) and the AS2 variable name string (line 1834), but discards all of them — they are neither stored in the Fla8Text interface nor forwarded in flash8-import.ts convertFla8Text().

Task 0833 fixed the model/UI/SWF side (TextDisplayObject now has password/maxChars/hasBorder fields, DefineEditText encodes them). The FLA import side is still missing.

Steps:
1. Add password, maxChars, hasBorder, multiline (from bit 0x10, not content heuristic) and as2VariableName fields to Fla8Text interface in flash8-binary.ts
2. Read and store them from textFlags and the skipped bytes in readCPicText()
3. Forward them in convertFla8Text() in flash8-import.ts

Note: multiline at line 856 is currently inferred from text content (el.text.includes('\r')) instead of the actual bit 0x10 — this mis-classifies empty multiline input fields as non-multiline.

COMPLETED:
- Fla8Text interface in flash8-binary.ts now has all 5 fields (multiline, password, maxChars, hasBorder, as2VariableName) as required fields
- readCPicText now reads maxChars (u16) and as2VariableName (CString) instead of skipping/discarding them
- Both convertElement and convertFla8Text in flash8-import.ts forward all new fields to TextDisplayObject
- TextDisplayObject in types.ts has as2VariableName?: string
- makeFla8Text test helper updated with all new required fields
- All 303 test files pass (4776 tests)

Commits: e955bb8 (QA run 5), f29a9a2 (types.ts as2VariableName), 83d2309 (test helper)
